description: Get full details for a specific quantum computing paper by its arXiv ID (e.g., "2401.12345"). Use after searchPapers or getLatestPapers when the user wants to dive deep into a specific paper. Returns: complete abstract, all authors, publication date, AI-generated tags with reasons, hook (one-line summary), methodology, gist, and key findings. Requires a valid paper_id from search results. Returns error if not found.
name: getPaperDetails
title: Paper Details
